text:
Jen: Rolling unpin v2.14 -> v2.15 in eu-staging. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. @deploy-bot, gate on SDK compatibility and run smoke.
Owen: Quick reminder: SDK 3.2.1 vs 3.2.2 header change (X-Model-Bind) caused hosted fallbacks last month.
Jen: Exactly. Don't want staging to mirror that.
Maria: Perf-lab runs on v2.15 showed +2-4% kv-cache miss for longseq. Not fatal but watch tail latency.
Tony: Can deploy-bot check node SDKs and abort if any < 3.2.2? Prefer abort rather than asymmetric routing.
deploy-bot: compatibility-check --region eu-staging --runtime v2.15 --min-sdk 3.2.2
Kira: Add smoke: POST /v1/generate with 1024-token prefix; assert p50 < 220ms, p99 < 360ms. Fail => rollback.
Owen: Adding canary job now (ci/canary-eu-staging-smoke:kv-longseq). PR in 4m.
deploy-bot: compatibility-check result: 4/12 nodes report SDK 3.2.1, 8/12 report 3.2.2. Action: ABORT unpin. Notified release owners.
Jen: Okay, hold. We'll not proceed until uniform SDK.
infra-bot: Scheduled SDK roll on nodes n4,n7,n9,n11 at 22:00 UTC (maintenance window requested).
Tony: If infra can't finish tonight, alternative is targeted pin exceptions for those nodes, but that complicates routing. Prefer full roll.
Maria: Posting note to support: "eu-staging runtime unpin delayed due to mixed SDK versions; SDK upgrade scheduled."
Kira: If we end up doing extended canary, include prefix-cache heatmap and kv miss rate threshold in runbook.
Owen: Smoke PR merged. CI will run after deploy-bot greenlights canary.
deploy-bot: abort-notice posted to #eng-releases and DMed to @Jen @Owen. To retry: `deploy-bot retry-unpin --thread 1762001234` after compatibility-check passes.
Jen: Coordinating with infra, will update thread when nodes are patched. Leaving pinned for now. :thumbsup:
